# Dot Catch

maker: G · with: — · parent: — · session: —

## Pitch

Slide a basket along the bottom and catch the falling dots.

## Rules

- R1 (auto): Holding right moves the basket right 2 pixels per frame, and it stops at the right edge.
- R2 (auto): Catching a dot adds 10 to the score.
- R3 (auto): Missing a dot takes away one life. At 0 lives the game-over screen shows.
- R4 (you check): The dots look like shiny gold coins.
- R5 (auto): Pressing START on the game-over screen starts a new game with 3 lives and a score of 0.

## Controls

- Player 1: stick moves the basket left and right.
- START: new game after game over.
- ★ is the cabinet's button; games never use it.

## Look & sound

A dark sky, gold dots, a tan basket. A coin sound for each catch.

## Assumptions

- A1: Three lives.
